assets.label: workshop hoists and press
assets.service: heavy vehicle component removal and pressing

control_failures.control_label: dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy
proving zero energy before intrusive work

facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: injury during routine operation on PR-9410

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control STORED_ENERGY_DISSIPATION: the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was never verified as effective, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control ZERO_ENERGY_VERIFICATION: the proving zero energy before intrusive work was not in place, and the accident investigation classified this as an organisational factor.

recommendations: Restore the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy on PR-9410 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in applying and verifying an isolation, specifically dissipating trapped and residual energy. PR-9410 (workshop hoists and press) is in service for heavy vehicle component removal and pressing. The task proceeded during routine operation while the dissipation or restraint of trapped and residual energy was never verified as effective. The kinetic energy involved is held as rotating equipment, and the recorded presentation was entanglement, impact, crush.
response.summary: On 10 February 2008 an incident occurred on PR-9410 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during routine operation, releasing kinetic energy held as rotating equipment.
